name: AI Penpot
description: Reads live Penpot design context via the Penpot RPC API and exposes it to Drupal AI Agent tools, so the Canvas AI assistant can build from a real design.
project_description:
AI Penpot connects a Penpot design to Drupal's AI Agent tooling. It talks to the Penpot RPC API (<base>/api/rpc/command/<command>) from server-side PHP using a stored access token, and exposes two AI Agent function-call tools so the Drupal Canvas AI assistant can build pages and components from the real design rather than a screenshot: Penpot: List Design Pages returns every page id of a file in order, and Penpot: Read Design Context returns one page's colours, typography, verbatim text content and a shape outline.

The module is config-driven and theme-agnostic. Configuration lives at Configuration -> AI -> AI Penpot: the Penpot instance base URL (Penpot Cloud https://design.penpot.app or a self-hosted instance), the access token (selected from a Key entity, kept encrypted at rest via easy_encryption), and an optional default file id. A Test Penpot connection button probes the API with the saved settings. On install the module provisions a `penpot` Key (empty value, admin pastes the token) and, when the ai_context module is present, seeds three editable AI Context items (Penpot Build Rules, Penpot Accessibility Rules, and an optional Penpot Component Mapping Governance) that guide how designs are built.

What it provides: two AI function-call plugins (ai_penpot:list_design_pages, ai_penpot:design_context), a PenpotContextClient service that fetches and summarizes design tokens, a settings form, two permissions, and config schema. It is the Penpot counterpart of AI Figma. Requirements: Drupal ^11.2, AI (drupal/ai), AI Agents, Key and Easy Encryption, plus a Penpot instance and an access token.
